title: Qwen-Image 2.1 prompting guide for MCP, the in-app agent and Enhance
description: Fabio 2026-10-09: first order of business after MPI-936. Qwen-Image 2.1 (MPI-936, closed db44011cb) has NO guide of its own: models.js sets enhanceRecipe 'flux' (comment: no 'qwen' recipe registered), so MCP read_knowledge, Cosmo and Enhance all get the SHARED guide:flux-2 (docs/agent/models/flux-2.md, also Klein/Boogu/Qwen Edit). Build a Qwen 2.1 recipe + guide with /create-enhancer-recipe (research -> draft -> autonomous test loop) and point the ModelDef at it; then the playbook 07 read-back (guide ids) + agent tests. Facts to carry: cfg 1 (negative does nothing), 25 steps, transparency only on t2i/edit via 'transparent background, alpha channel' in the prompt, up to 8 refs on edit, edit refs named image 1/2, research licence. Bench prompts: tasks/MPI-936/research/bench/run.py.
